projects.metaDescription: Bayshore Oasis is a BTO project launched on November 2026 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Bayshore estate, which consist of 2-room Flexi and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is September 2030. Download Bayshore Oasis floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Located in the Bayshore estate in Bedok, Bayshore Oasis is bounded by Bayshore Drive and Bayshore Walk. The project comprises 4 residential blocks ranging from 7 to 30 storeys, providing 855 units of 2-room Flexi and 4-room flats offered as Plus flats. 1 of the blocks will house an additional 30 units of rental flats.

Complementing its proximity to East Coast Park and its location adjacent to a proposed park, Bayshore Oasis is designed with an open central green space that flows seamlessly through the precinct, creating a refreshing and restorative living environment for residents, which inspired the project's name. Some of the 4-room flats at Bayshore Oasis will be provided with full-height windows.

Bayshore Oasis will offer a good mix of commercial, recreational, and communal facilities. These include a minimart, shops, children's playgrounds, fitness corners, shelters, and precinct pavilions. A preschool is conveniently located at the ground level of the Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP), adding convenience for young families. The roof garden atop the MSCP will feature an adult fitness station, a community gardening area, and a shelter overlooking the surrounding greenery. Additional roof gardens on 3 of the residential blocks provide residents with spaces to relax and enjoy the scenic surroundings.

projects.metaDescription: Bayshore Sails is a BTO project launched on November 2026 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Bayshore estate, which consist of 2-room Flexi, 3-room, and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is March 2031. Download Bayshore Sails floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Bounded by Bayshore Road and Bayshore Drive, Bayshore Sails is located in the Bayshore estate in Bedok. The project consists of 7 residential blocks ranging from 7 to 34 storeys, and offers 1,637 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-room, and 4-room flats. 1 of the blocks will house an additional 58 units of rental flats. The sold flats are offered as Plus flats.

Taking inspiration from its location near the water and the historic sailboat races in Bedok, Bayshore Sails features a nautical-inspired design. The roof crowns of the residential blocks reference the curved form of mainsails and the sloping form of headsails, while wave-inspired elements and horizontal bands across the façades further evoke the movement of the water. A number of the 4-room flats will also feature full-height windows for residents to enjoy views towards East Coast Park.

Bayshore Sails will come with shops and an eating house, as well as community facilities including preschools, residents’ network centre, Active Ageing Centre (Care), and kidney dialysis centre. Recreational facilities such as children’s playgrounds, fitness stations, and a hardcourt will also be provided. Residents can enjoy more green and recreational spaces at the roof gardens atop the Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) and preschool block, as well as at the ninth storey of residential blocks fronting Bayshore Drive.

projects.metaDescription: Merpati Meadow is a BTO project launched on November 2026 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Geylang estate, which consist of 2-room Flexi and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is September 2030. Download Merpati Meadow floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Located along Merpati Road, Merpati Meadow comprises 3 residential blocks of 18 storeys, providing 438 units of 2-room Flexi and 4-room flats offered as Plus flats.

The project is named ‘Merpati Meadow’ in recognition of its green surroundings, with Aljunied Park sitting adjacent to the site, and a common green opposite Jalan Anggerek. The name also complements nearby road names inspired by flowers, such as Jalan Anggerek (orchid) and Jalan Melati (jasmine). Reflecting this botanical theme, the building facades draw inspiration from flowers in bloom, with a gradient palette of yellow, orange, and red to create a vibrant yet harmonious visual identity for the precinct.

Merpati Meadow will offer a range of facilities including children's playgrounds, fitness stations, a precinct pavilion, and a preschool at the ground level of the Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP). Atop the MSCP, a roof garden provides residents with lush landscaping and sheltered seating. Additional playgrounds, fitness stations, and a multi-purpose court will also be available at the common green.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Toa Payoh Hillside is bounded by Toa Payoh Rise and Toa Payoh Link, and its name is inspired by the hilly topography of Toa Payoh West. The project comprises 5 residential blocks, ranging from 31 to 43 storeys. This includes 1 rental block of 232 rental flats, and 4 residential blocks consisting of 1,432 units of Community Care Apartments (CCAs), 2-room Flexi, and 4-room flats. Some 4-room flats will come with a balcony. The sold flats are offered as Prime flats.

Located in Block 410C, the CCAs integrate senior-friendly housing with care services that can be scaled according to care needs and social activities to support seniors to age independently within the community. A residents’ network centre and active ageing centre within Toa Payoh Hillside will offer opportunities for residents, including seniors, to interact and stay connected. Together with elderly fitness stations within the precinct, these facilities contribute to a holistic senior living environment.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Bounded by Upper Thomson Road, Lakeview Cascadia comprises 5 residential blocks. The project ranges from 18 to 40 storeys in height, with 1,221 units of 2-room Flexi and 4-room flats. These flats will be offered as Prime flats under the new flat classification framework. 2 of these blocks will include a total of 50 rental flats.

Lakeview Cascadia derives its name from the project’s cascading architectural form, designed to complement the surrounding landscape and the nearby MacRitchie Reservoir. Residents can enjoy recreational facilities such as children’s playgrounds and fitness stations for adults and seniors. A residents' network centre will provide space for community activities and neighbourly interaction. The Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) features commercial amenities such as a minimart, shops, an eating house, and a preschool. Atop the MSCP, a roof garden offers an adult fitness station, a hardcourt, and a community garden to encourage social bonding.

projects.metaDescription: Berlayar Rise is a BTO project launched on June 2026 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Bukit Merah estate, which consist of 2-room Flexi, 3-room, and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is September 2029. Download Berlayar Rise floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Berlayar Rise is located next to Telok Blangah MRT Station and bounded by Berlayar Street and Berlayar Drive. The project comprises 6 residential blocks, ranging from 33 to 49 storeys in height, offering a total of 1,976 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-room, and 4-room flats. These flats are offered as Prime flats under the new flat classification framework.

The project’s name pays homage to the area's maritime heritage, with ‘Berlayar’ translating to 'sailing' in Malay. This references the historic 'Batu Berlayar', a granite outcrop that once guided maritime traders to Singapore's shores from as early as the 14th century. The name ‘Berlayar Rise’ also reflects the project's tall residential blocks, where selected sky terraces and roof gardens offer panoramic views of the surrounding area.

Berlayar Rise features a range of facilities for residents of all ages, including a 3-storey preschool, a residents’ network centre, nature-themed playgrounds, fitness corners, and a hardcourt. The 6-storey Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) will house commercial spaces at the ground level, including a supermarket, an eating house, restaurants, cafes, and shops. Above the MSCP, a roof garden with fitness facilities and shelters provides additional space for recreation and relaxation.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Oak Ville @ AMK is bounded by Ang Mo Kio Street 82, Ang Mo Kio Street 81, and Ang Mo Kio Avenue 5. The project comprises 1,425 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-, and 4-room flats spread across 6 residential blocks ranging from 21 to 24 storeys high. The flats at Oak Ville @ AMK will be offered as Plus flats under the new flat classification framework.

The project’s name complements the adjacent Pine Ville @ AMK, and is inspired by the green corridor running between the 2 projects. This corridor connects residents to a proposed new park to the north and to the park connector along Ang Mo Kio Avenue 5. The landscape design at Oak Ville @ AMK also reflects the area's rich agricultural heritage, which once included thriving gambier and rubber plantations. A notable feature is the rubber tapping trail, where a path lined with columnar trees is accompanied by interpretive panels showcasing the traditional rubber tapping process.

The project features 4 residential blocks ranging from 19 to 46 storeys. 3 blocks will comprise 880 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-room, and 4-room flats, which will be offered as Prime flats under the new flat classification framework, while the 4th block will house rental flats.

The name 'Berlayar', meaning 'sailing' in Malay, celebrates the area's maritime legacy. The historical significance stems from 'Batu Berlayar', a granite outcrop that served as a navigational marker guiding maritime traders to Singapore's shores since the 14th century. To enrich the unique identity and natural heritage of the estate, the project will adopt a white and blue colour palette that mirrors its setting near the waterfront. Motifs of fauna species found in the area will also be incorporated into the design of community living rooms and wayfinding signages.

Named after its 3 soaring residential towers of 40 to 49 storeys in height, the project comprises 1,021 units of 2-room Flexi and 4-room flats. projects.metaDescription: Fernvale Plains is a BTO project launched on Oct 2025 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Sengkang estate, which consist of Community Care Apartments (CCA), 2-room Flexi, 4-room, and 5-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is March 2029. Download Fernvale Plains floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Fernvale Plains is bounded by Fernvale Drive, Fernvale Link, and Fernvale Street. The project comprises 5 residential blocks ranging from 23 to 26 storeys, including 1 rental block and 4 residential blocks, with a total of 1,037 units of Community Care Apartments (CCA), 2-room Flexi, 4-room, and 5-room flats. These flats will be offered as Standard flats under the new flat classification framework, and are Shorter Waiting Time (SWT) flats with waiting times of less than 3 years.

The CCA is an assisted living public housing concept designed to integrate senior-friendly living with on-site social activities, and customised care services according to the individual's care needs in their silver years. Located in Block 481B next to a future nursing home, the CCA features furnished communal areas on selected floors to foster social connections. Together with elderly fitness stations within the precinct, these facilities form part of a holistic senior living environment.

Fernvale Plains also offers recreational and communal spaces for residents of all ages. 2 unique gardens at the ground level feature children’s playgrounds, fitness stations, and a hardcourt in one, while the other offers a more tranquil setting. A Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) crowned with a roof garden provides additional green space for relaxation, while an adjacent common green offers more outdoor recreational options. The MSCP also houses a preschool at the ground level.

projects.metaDescription: Bayshore Palms is a BTO project launched on Oct 2024 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Bedok estate, which consist of 2-room Flexi and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is June 2029. Download Bayshore Palms floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Bayshore Palms is one of the first two Build-To-Order projects launched in the new Bayshore estate in Bedok. Located along Bayshore Drive, the project consists of five residential blocks, ranging from 7 to 21 storeys, providing a total of 710 units of 2-room Flexi and 4-room flats. These flats will be offered as Plus flats under the new flat classification. Additionally, two of the blocks will house 40 rental flats.

Inspired by its proximity to East Coast Park, Bayshore Palms is designed with imagery of palm trees, boats, and sail-like forms, capturing the essence of idyllic waterside living. This design pays tribute to the area's history, where coconut and nipah palms once thrived, and fishing vessels lined the shore. To optimize water views, some 4-room flats at Bayshore Palms will feature full-height windows.

Residents will have access to various amenities within the development. A two-storey social and commercial block, which includes an eating house and a preschool, will be provided. Additional shops will also be located on the first storey of Blk 916B. The project features a range of recreational and communal spaces designed to enhance residents’ well-being, including 3-Generation (3G) playgrounds on the ground floor and at the roof garden atop the two-storey social and commercial block. Sky terraces and roof gardens on the ninth storey of two residential blocks provide ideal spots for residents to unwind and socialize. Another roof garden atop the Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) will include a fitness corner, community garden, and an open lawn.

Unit Type Total Units Indicative Price Range
2-Room Flexi 160 $67,000 - $326,000
4-Room 550 $495,000 - $683,000

The estimated T.O.P is September 2027. Download West BrickVille @ Bukit Batok floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Nestled between Bukit Batok Road to the west and Bukit Batok West Avenue 8 to the east, West BrickVille @ Bukit Batok will feature 689 units, including 2-room Flexi, 3-, 4-, 5-room, and 3Gen flats. The five residential blocks are thoughtfully arranged to create a central open space, providing a lively area for recreational and community activities, complete with children's playgrounds and fitness corners. With a reduced waiting time of approximately two years, these flats will be available as Standard flats under the new classification system.

The name “West BrickVille @ Bukit Batok” is inspired by traditional bricklaying techniques, which are reflected in the building’s façade, where “bricks” of paint are arranged in a rising gradient that extends to the gable ends. This design pays homage to the historical brick factories that once thrived in the area. The project's landscape concept creatively mimics the flowing form of kiln smoke, featuring winding jogging and cycling paths that traverse the precinct's central green. These paths connect various outdoor amenities, such as playgrounds and fitness areas, fostering a cohesive environment that promotes community interaction and an active lifestyle. This theme continues in the rooftop garden of the Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP), where a winding walkway links community gardens with viewpoints showcasing the Bukit Batok skyline. Through these integrated elements, the project honors Bukit Batok's industrial heritage while nurturing a modern, connected community.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Located next to Mattar MRT and along Merpati Road, Merpati Alcove consists of two 18-storey residential blocks, offering a total of 433 units of Community Care Apartments (CCA) and 4-room flats. These flats will be available as Plus flats under the new flat classification. The CCA is an assisted living public housing concept, designed to integrate senior-friendly living with on-site social activities and personalized care services tailored to individuals’ needs in their silver years. Situated in Block 136A, the CCA will provide furnished communal spaces on each floor to foster social connections, along with a dedicated CCA Activity Centre to enhance seniors’ engagement and well-being. Elderly fitness stations will be strategically placed throughout the precinct to promote active ageing.

Envisioned as a peaceful retreat within an urban setting, the park located between the two residential blocks of Merpati Alcove will serve as the heart of the community, offering a space for residents to gather and build connections. This layout creates a welcoming and sheltered environment, reflecting the name ‘Merpati Alcove’.

Merpati Alcove will also offer various facilities, including children's playgrounds, fitness stations, a preschool, and recreational spaces for quiet respite, such as shelters and pavilions. projects.descriptionHtml:
Bounded by Woodlands Centre Road to the west, Marsiling Ridge features a single residential block offering 292 units of 4- and 5-room flats, which will be available as Standard flats under the new flat classification.

The name ‘Marsiling Ridge’ reflects its elevated location, with a high-rise 34-storey residential block standing prominently amid the surrounding lower blocks. The facade design pays tribute to the area’s history, incorporating the diagonal pattern of rubber tapping, reminiscent of the former rubber plantations along Marsiling Road. This pattern, displayed on the gable-end walls, is reinterpreted throughout the precinct, giving the development a distinct visual identity. Ground-level green and timber accents further enhance this unique sense of identity among residents.

Residents of Marsiling Ridge will enjoy a central open space with children's playgrounds and fitness stations, fostering a communal area where residents of all ages can bond and stay active. The Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) includes a roof garden, offering additional recreational facilities such as fitness stations, a community garden, and sheltered spaces. A preschool is conveniently located on the first storey of the MSCP, providing easy access for families. The communal amenities are completed by a precinct pavilion, strategically located near the centralised drop-off point for convenience.

projects.metaDescription: Tanjong Rhu Riverfront I & II is a BTO project launched on Jun 2024 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Yishun estate, which consist of 2-room Flexi, 3-room, and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is December 2029. Download Tanjong Rhu Riverfront I & II floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Overlooking the scenic Geylang River, Tanjong Rhu Riverfront I & II are bounded by Tanjong Rhu Road, Kampong Arang Road, and Sampan Place. The projects are offered under the Prime Location Public Housing (PLH) model, and comprise 2,063 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-, and 4-room flats spread across 11 residential blocks ranging from 8 to 29 storeys high. The layout and heights of the blocks are designed to optimise views of the Geylang River, and common green areas located between the projects.

Inspired by the riverfront location of the projects, the design of Tanjong Rhu Riverfront I & II, particularly the sampan-inspired shapes adorning the top of the residential blocks, pays homage to the boat culture of yesteryear.

Numerous facilities are planned within Tanjong Rhu Riverfront I & II, to provide residents with conveniences right at their doorstep. At Tanjong Rhu Riverfront I, there will be a 1-storey ancillary block that would house a preschool. Over at Tanjong Rhu Riverfront II, there will be a residents’ network centre, a 2-storey ancillary block with a preschool and restaurants, and another 2-storey commercial block with an eating house, a supermarket, and shops. A 6-storey and 7-storey Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) will serve Tanjong Rhu Riverfront I & II respectively. The ancillary and MSCP blocks will come with roof gardens and viewing decks to take in sights of the Geylang River, which also function as community spaces. Both projects will offer more facilities amidst lush greenery, such as children’s playgrounds, adult and elderly fitness stations, hardcourts, precinct pavilions, and rest shelters.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Nestled between Holland Village Way and Holland Drive, Holland Vista is a 40-storey residential block seamlessly integrated with the adjacent park. Sharing its name with the neighbouring HDB project, Holland Vista is seen as an extension of the existing precinct. Offered under the Prime Location Public Housing (PLH) model, Holland Vista features 342 units of 2-room Flexi and 4-room flats. The project also includes a preschool, a residents' network centre, and an Active Ageing Centre.

Situated within the Health District @ Queenstown, Holland Vista offers an array of recreational and communal facilities aimed at enhancing residents' physical, social, and mental well-being. Designed to encourage an active lifestyle, the natural slopes of the site have been used to create a combination of trails, ramps, and stairs, making it easy to incorporate exercise into daily routines for residents of all fitness levels.

Additionally, playgrounds and fitness stations are thoughtfully integrated at the ground floor and roof garden atop the Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP). The existing HDB neighbourhood park nearby will be upgraded, along with a new park extension that includes playground and fitness facilities. The nearby Rail Corridor also offers further access to more recreational spaces for leisure and outdoor activities.

projects.metaDescription: Chencharu Hills is a BTO project launched on Jun 2024 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Yishun estate, which consist of 2-room Flexi, 3-room, 4-room and 5-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is December 2028. Download Chencharu Hills floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Chencharu Hills is the first Build-To-Order project in Chencharu at Yishun, and is located along Lorong Chencharu. The project comprises 10 residential blocks ranging from 14 to 15 storeys and offers 1,277 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-, 4-, and 5-room flats.

The name ‘Chencharu Hills’ describes the project’s undulating terrain and lush surroundings, as it is situated next to a new park where an existing black and white bungalow will be retained. The project’s facade colours of red, black, and white will complement the colours of the colonial bungalow. Residents will enjoy the convenience of having a preschool, senior care centre, eating house, shops, and a minimart provided within the project. Chencharu Hills will also feature children’s playgrounds, adult and elderly fitness stations, precinct pavilions, and 2 Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) with roof gardens. Within the new park, there will be playgrounds, fitness corners, open lawns, hard courts for sports, and a therapeutic garden. A heritage trail, featuring a series of gardens and storyboards, will also be incorporated for residents to learn about the area’s history.

At the heart of Chencharu, an east-west community avenue will connect a new park to the existing neighbourhood park near Khatib MRT. There will be a mixed-use Integrated Development along this community avenue, comprising of a new bus interchange, hawker centre, and shops to create a lively public space where residents can mingle.

Future residents of Chencharu will enjoy good transport connectivity. A new road, Chencharu Link, will run north-south through the centre of Chencharu, flanked with housing developments and amenities on both sides. The 400-metre road will be designated as a bus-only corridor, providing dedicated road space for smoother bus journeys. With the bus interchange in the new Integrated Development and existing public transport options like Khatib MRT station and bus services along Yishun Avenue 2 and Sembawang Road, residents will enjoy seamless public transport connectivity within and outside of Yishun town. Besides convenient public transport options, Chencharu will feature walking and cycling paths that connect to amenities and transport nodes safely. These paths will also connect to the cycling network beyond Yishun, giving cyclists easy access to neighbouring towns like Sembawang, recreation nodes such as Khatib Bongsu and Lower Seletar Reservoir, as well as the upcoming North-South Corridor.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Discover the Serenity of Woodgrove Edge: Where Nature Meets Modern Living

Nestled between the vibrant avenues of Woodgrove and Rosewood Drive, Woodgrove Edge stands as a testament to sophisticated living harmonized with nature's touch. This exquisite enclave is defined by its distinctive charm, with a sprawling linear park gracing its southern frontier, offering residents a serene backdrop to their dynamic lifestyles.

Elevate Your Lifestyle Across Sky-High Horizons

Woodgrove Edge presents a collection of 7 meticulously designed residential blocks, soaring between 15 and 16 storeys. With 1,127 units ranging from versatile 2-room Flexi flats to spacious 3-, 4-, and 5-room apartments, finding your perfect sanctuary has never been easier. Each home is crafted to invite ample natural light, offering breathtaking views that promise to elevate your living experience.

A Haven of Convenience and Leisure

Woodgrove Edge is a self-contained oasis featuring a minimart, an array of shops, a welcoming eating house, and a preschool, ensuring your daily needs are just a stone's throw away. The residents' network centre stands as a hub for community engagement and interaction, fostering a warm and inclusive environment.

Embrace an Active Lifestyle Amidst Lush Greenery

With multiple playgrounds and fitness stations peppered throughout, Woodgrove Edge is designed to inspire an active and healthy way of life for all ages. Not one, but two rooftop gardens crown our Multi-Storey Car Parks, offering idyllic green spaces for relaxation and social connection. The proximity to a future park further expands your options for outdoor activities, ensuring that adventure and tranquility go hand in hand.

Your Gateway to a Balanced Life

At Woodgrove Edge, every day is an opportunity to balance the hustle and bustle of modern living with moments of peace and recreation. It's not just a residence; it's a lifestyle destination where every detail is curated for your ultimate comfort and enjoyment.

Welcome to Woodgrove Edge – Your Dream Home Awaits.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Chai Chee Green is bounded by Bedok North Road and Chai Chee Lane. The project comprises 7 residential blocks of 15 storeys and 2 Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) blocks. You can choose from 1,234 units of Community Care Apartments, 3-, 4-, and 5-room flats.

The Community Care Apartments is a public housing assisted living concept that integrates senior-friendly housing with on-site social activities and care services that can be customised according to the individual’s care needs to support seniors to age independently in their silver years within the community. Community Care Apartments are offered to seniors (aged 65 years and above) on short leases between 15 and 35 years (in 5-year increments), where the lease chosen must be able to cover the applicant and spouse (if any) until at least the age of 95 years. Within Blk 816B which houses the Community Care Apartments, there will be furnished communal spaces on every floor for residents to mingle and bond with one another, share meals, or participate in programmes specially curated by the community manager. This helps to build meaningful social networks and enhances seniors' engagement and well-being.

The project’s name pays homage to Chai Chee’s historical background as a vegetable marketplace, with the residential blocks lined up in a linear formation, mimicking the rows of shops within a market. projects.descriptionHtml:
Ulu Pandan Vista is bounded by Commonwealth Ave West and the Ulu Pandan Park Connector. The project comprises 3 residential blocks ranging from 34 to 45 storeys, and offers 890 units of 3- and 4-room flats. Ulu Pandan Vista is offered under the Prime Location Public Housing (PLH) model.

The name ‘Ulu Pandan Vista’ embodies the lush greenery offered by the surrounding landscape and the Ulu Pandan Park Connector that residents can enjoy. In developing the area, HDB has considered the findings from the Environmental Baseline Study and Ecological Profiling Exercise, as well as feedback from Nature Groups and the community. The site will be developed to support the local biodiversity while enhancing residents’ well-being. The sky terraces and roof gardens at the residential blocks and atop the Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) are ideal spots for residents to mingle with one another, or simply to unwind and relax.

As part of the Health District @ Queenstown, Ulu Pandan Vista boasts a variety of recreational and communal facilities to enhance residents’ physical, social, and mental well-being. These include children’s playgrounds, and adult and elderly fitness stations for the active. Residents can also exercise or jog along the adjacent Ulu Pandan Canal Linear Park.

A wide range of amenities including shops, a supermarket, food and beverage outlets, and a preschool will be provided in the project. Please refer to the site plan located at the top of this page for the facilities provided in the project. Facilities in this project will be accessible by the public.

Verandah @ Kallang is offered under the Prime Location Public Housing (PLH) model. Residents will enjoy conveniences right at their doorstep with the project’s 2-storey commercial block, which would provide amenities such as an eating house, shops, a minimart, a residents’ network centre, and a preschool. The name ‘Verandah @ Kallang’ describes the covered walkway along the 2-storey commercial block which reflects the streetscape of the shophouses along Geylang Road. The covered walkway further extends into the project’s void decks, providing connectivity to all the nodes and amenities for the residents. Recreational facilities at Verandah @ Kallang include fitness corners for adults and the elderly, children’s playgrounds, a hardcourt, and roof gardens above the commercial block and Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP). projects.descriptionHtml:
Tanglin Halt Cascadia is bounded by Commonwealth Drive and the Rail Corridor, a 24km long recreational corridor that connects the north and south of Singapore. The project is offered under the Prime Location Public Housing (PLH) model, and comprises 4 residential blocks. The 2 taller blocks range from 34 to 47 storeys, while the other 2 blocks are between 10 to 25 storeys. The staggered height of the blocks, and the project’s location gave inspiration to its name. Residents can choose from 973 units of 3- and 4-room flats.

Located within the Health District @ Queenstown, Tanglin Halt Cascadia boasts a variety of recreational and communal facilities that enhance residents’ physical, social, and mental well-being. These include playgrounds for children, as well as fitness stations for adults and the elderly. The sky terraces and roof gardens at the residential blocks and atop the Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) are ideal spots for residents to mingle and interact with one another, or simply to unwind and relax. Residents can also exercise along the adjacent Rail Corridor. A preschool will be located within Tanglin Halt Cascadia, bringing convenience to families with young children.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Located at the edge of Tengah’s Plantation district, Plantation Edge I and II are bounded by Plantation Crescent and Plantation Close. Residents can choose from 1,010 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-, 4-, and 5-room flats, housed in 8 residential blocks ranging from 14 to 15 storeys. Within these blocks, 2 of them will also house some rental flats. There will be 1 other residential block of rental flats, making up a total of 9 residential blocks in these projects.

Plantation Edge I and II are designed as vibrant residential hubs that are well-connected to the adjacent JE2 MRT station, neighbouring housing precincts, and amenities within the projects, such as a 3-storey preschool, residents' network centre, supermarket, eating house, and shops. They will also serve as additional venues for relaxation and exercising.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Ulu Pandan Glades is located near Dover MRT station and bounded by Ghim Moh Link and Commonwealth Avenue West. The project comprises 2 residential blocks of 34 to 43 storeys. You can choose from 732 units of 3- and 4-room flats. Ulu Pandan Glades is offered under the Prime Location Public Housing (PLH) model.

The name ‘Ulu Pandan Glades’ describes the project’s lush surrounding, as it is located next to Ulu Pandan Park Connector and a park with a retained natural stream. In developing the plans of the area, HDB has considered the findings from the Environmental Baseline Study and Ecological Profiling Exercise, feedback from Nature Groups and the community, and the site context. The site will be developed to support the local biodiversity, with green and blue elements weaved in, while enhancing residents’ well-being. Residents of Ulu Pandan Glades will get to enjoy the project’s lush central garden space, as well as the sky terraces and roof gardens on both residential blocks.

As part of the Health District @ Queenstown, Ulu Pandan Glades boasts a variety of recreational and communal facilities to enhance residents’ physical, social, and mental well-being. These include children’s playgrounds, adult and elderly fitness stations, and a communal roof garden on top of the Multi-storey Carpark. There will also be a childcare centre and therapeutic garden located within the project. Please refer to the site plan located at the top of this page for the facilities provided in Ulu Pandan Glades. Facilities in this project will be accessible by the public.

Located in the Brickland District of Tengah town, Brickland Weave is bounded by Brickland Road and Tengah Boulevard. This project comprises 12 residential blocks, ranging from 11 to 17 storeys in height. You can choose a home from 1,641 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-, 4-, and 5-room flats.

Within Brickland Weave, various facilities are nestled amid pockets of green spaces for both the young and old. Here, adults and the elderly can work out at the fitness stations, while children enjoy the playgrounds. The landscaped roof gardens above the Multi-Storey Car Parks cater to those who prefer quieter spaces. More recreational facilities can be found at the adjacent common green where one can jog, play, or unwind amid greenery.

Daily conveniences are also within easy reach, as Brickland Weave will come with shops, eating houses, and a minimart. A residents’ network centre and a 3-storey childcare centre will be located within the project as well. In addition, residents will be served by the planned amenities in Tengah town such as a Neighbourhood Centre, Jurong Region Line MRT stations and a bus interchange. They will be served by bus services leading to the city centre and nearby towns. With an extensive network of walking and cycling paths, residents will also be able to walk and cycle everywhere in Tengah.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Located along the Kallang River, Kallang Horizon is bounded by Lorong 1 Geylang and the Kallang MRT station. This development comprises 3 residential blocks ranging from 26 to 30 storeys with a choice of 477 units consisting of 3- and 4-room flats. Kallang Horizon is offered under the Prime Location Public Housing (PLH) model.

There is a bus interchange within the development, sited next to the Kallang MRT station. The roof of the bus interchange will be home to an extensive landscaped deck that comes with a variety of recreational and communal activities for residents to enjoy. These include children’s playgrounds, fitness stations, shelters, and trellises. The precinct pavilion in the development will have an exercise deck located on its roof and is orientated to face the Kallang River to provide great views and welcome residents home. Roof gardens located on 2 of the residential blocks provide residents with more spaces to enjoy the scenic river views. A childcare centre and a residents’ network centre will also be provided within the development.

projects.metaDescription: Queensway Canopy is a BTO project launched on Nov 2022 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Queenstown estate, which consist of Community Care Apartments, 3-room, and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is December 2028. Download Queensway Canopy floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Bounded by Queensway, Queen’s Crescent, and the Rail Corridor, Queensway Canopy is designed to take advantage of the scenic surroundings and its proximity to the Rail Corridor. The 5 residential blocks will have staggered heights, from 6 to 40 storeys, and are orientated to maximise the views from their units. You can choose from 996 units of Community Care Apartments, 3-, and 4-room flats. The Community Care Apartments will feature assisted living provisions, which integrates senior-friendly design features with care services and social programmes to let you live your golden years with peace of mind. This assisted living concept is designed for seniors to live an active lifestyle, enjoy independence, and connect with friends. The Community Care Apartments are offered to seniors (aged 65 and above) on short leases between 15 and 35 years (in 5-year increments), where the lease chosen must be able to cover the applicant and spouse (if any) until at least the age of 95 years. The residential block with the Community Care Apartments is expected to complete in 3Q2028.

Within the block housing Community Care Apartments, there will be furnished communal spaces on each floor for residents to mingle and build social networks. You can use these furnished spaces to catch up with neighbours and share meals at the communal spaces, or participate in group activities.

Queensway Canopy is located within the Health District @ Queenstown. Residents will be able to access a range of initiatives that will be implemented to enhance their physical, social, and mental well-being. For example, Queensway Canopy will feature a range of recreational facilities to foster family and inter-generational bonding. These include children’s playgrounds, adult and elderly fitness stations, and a hardcourt. A childcare centre, an Active Ageing Centre (Care), and an ActiveSG Gym in collaboration with SportSG will also be located within the development. The roof gardens above some residential blocks and atop the Multi-Storey Car Parks (MSCP) make for ideal spots for residents to interact with one another or exercise. The side of the development facing the Rail Corridor will boast a stretch of inter-connecting roof gardens, acting as an extension of the canopy provided by the trees at ground level. The development derives its name from these roof gardens.

Unit Type Total Units Indicative Price Range
Community Care Apartment 245 $82,000 - $111,000
3-Room 88 $392,000 - $488,000
4-Room 663 $551,000 - $695,000

projects.metaDescription: Ulu Pandan Banks is a BTO project launched on Nov 2022 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Queenstown estate, which consist of 3-room and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is September 2029. Download Ulu Pandan Banks floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Bounded by Commonwealth Avenue West, Ghim Moh Link and the Ulu Pandan Park Connector, Ulu Pandan Banks is located near Dover MRT station. Its name references the Ulu Pandan Canal, which is located next to the site. In developing the plans, HDB has considered the findings from the Environmental Baseline Study and Ecological Profiling Exercise, feedback from Nature Groups and the community, as well as site context. The site will be developed sensitively, with green and blue elements weaved into the plans to support the local biodiversity, while enhancing residents’ well-being. The development comprises 7 residential blocks. 3 blocks have heights staggering from 33 to 44 storeys high, 2 blocks have varying heights from 10 to 12 storeys, while another 2 blocks range from 6 to 8 storeys in height. You can choose from 1,330 units of 3- and 4-room flats. Ulu Pandan Banks is offered under the Prime Location Public Housing (PLH) model.

Ulu Pandan Banks is located within the Health District @ Queenstown and will be designed with a variety of wellness choices for residents to experience a healthy and conducive living environment. For example, the development comes with a fitness trail at the skybridges linking 3 residential blocks at the 34th storey. It also features a range of recreational facilities closely located to one another to foster family and inter-generational bonding. These include playgrounds for children, fitness stations for adults and elderly, and a hardcourt. The sky terraces and roof gardens within all the residential blocks, and roof gardens atop the Multi-Storey Car Park make for ideal spots to exercise or rest while enjoying scenic views. Retained trees, pockets of bio-swales, and rain gardens on the grounds of the development provides a tranquil and green environment, while landscaped paths designed as restorative trails lead to the adjacent park and Ulu Pandan Park Connector where residents can be closer to nature.

Unit Type Total Units Indicative Price Range
3-Room 270 $362,000 - $504,000
4-Room 1060 $546,000 - $725,000

projects.descriptionHtml:
Located in the Garden District of Tengah town and right next to the Promenade Park lining the Tengah Pond, Garden Waterfront I & II @ Tengah are located along Tengah Garden Avenue. The 2 developments comprise 18 residential blocks, ranging from 9 to 16 storeys in height. 2 of the blocks in Garden Waterfront I @ Tengah will house some rental flats. You can choose a home from 2,077 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-, 4-, and 5-room flats.

Garden Waterfront I & II @ Tengah are located next to an upcoming MRT station on the Jurong Region Line, and will be near upcoming amenities such as a Neighbourhood Centre and a Community Club. The developments will also be served by bus services leading to the city centre and nearby towns. With an extensive network of walking and cycling paths, residents will be able to walk and cycle everywhere in Tengah.

Daily conveniences are within easy reach as Garden Waterfront I @ Tengah will come with shops, a supermarket, restaurants, an eating house, and a residents’ network centre. Childcare centres, playgrounds, and fitness stations are found in both Garden Waterfront I @ Tengah and Garden Waterfront II @ Tengah to provide added convenience. Roof gardens are located on some of the residential blocks and on both Multi-Storey Car Parks (MSCPs). In Garden Waterfront II @ Tengah, the roof garden on the MSCP is linked to nearby residential blocks via sky terraces.

projects.metaDescription: Ghim Moh Ascent is a BTO project launched on May 2022 BTO Sales Launch under the Prime Location Public Housing (PLH) Model that is located in Queenstown estate, which consist of 3-room and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is March 2028. Download Ghim Moh Ascent floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Bounded by Ghim Moh Road, Ghim Moh Close, and the Rail Corridor, Ghim Moh Ascent is located near Buona Vista MRT station. This development comprises 4 residential blocks. Two blocks are 40 storeys high and the other two blocks have varying heights ranging from 8 to 31 storeys. The name ‘Ghim Moh Ascent’ references the development’s location and the staggered height of the blocks. You can choose from 867 units of 3- and 4-room flats. Ghim Moh Ascent is offered under the new Prime Location Public Housing (PLH) model.

Ghim Moh Ascent is located within the Health District @ Queenstown. Residents of Ghim Moh Ascent will be able to access a range of initiatives that will be implemented to enhance their physical, social, and mental well-being. For example, Ghim Moh Ascent will feature a range of recreational facilities closely located to one another to foster family and inter-generational bonding. These include playgrounds for children, fitness stations for adults and elderly, and a hardcourt. The roof gardens on the 9th storey of some residential blocks and atop the MSCP also make for ideal spots for residents to interact with one another, or to unwind and relax. Additionally, Ghim Moh Ascent has been planned with good connectivity to the Rail Corridor and the Ulu Pandan Canal and Park Connector, where residents can be closer to nature and enjoy a variety of activities to boost their health. Other sports amenities in the town include the Queenstown Swimming Complex & Stadium.

In terms of Indicative Price Range, excluding grants, 3-Room from $369,000 - $481,000 and 4-room from $511,000 - $691,000.

projects.metaDescription: Kovan Wellspring is a BTO project launched on Aug 2021 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Hougang estate, which consist of 2-room Flexi, 3-room, and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is September 2026. Download Kovan Wellspring floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Kovan Wellspring will be integrated with a new Paya Lebar Kovan Community Club. Bounded by Upper Serangoon Road and Tampines Road, Kovan Wellspring is located next to Heartland Mall – Kovan, Kovan 209 Market and Food Centre, and Kovan MRT station. This development comprises 4 residential blocks ranging from 13 to 18 storeys. You can choose from 586 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-, and 4-room flats.

Kovan Wellspring takes its name from the well Tua Jia Kar ("foot of the big well"), which once supplied clean water to the kampong residents of the area. A replica of this well, which features a commemorative plaque, is located at the nearby Block 203.

In addition to the new Paya Lebar Kovan Community Club, Kovan Wellspring will come with a residents’ network centre and a childcare centre, adding vibrancy to the area. The landscaped deck, which will connect to all 4 residential blocks, will feature outdoor facilities such as playgrounds and fitness stations. The development will be served by both a single-storey car park beneath the landscaped deck and a 7-storey Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) with a roof garden. More outdoor facilities and greenery can also be found at the park, which will be part of the development.

In terms of Indicative Price Range, excluding grants, 2-Room from $153,000 - $234,000, 3-Room from $289,000 - $340,000 and 4-Room from $413,000 - $507,000

projects.metaDescription: Queen's Arc is a BTO project launched on Aug 2021 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Queenstown estate, which consist of 3-room, and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is September 2027. Download Queen's Arc floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Queen's Arc is bounded by Queen's Crescent and Queensway Drive. You can choose from the 610 units of 3- and 4-room flats on offer, which will be housed in 2 residential blocks ranging from 23 to 39 storeys. Together with an additional residential block of rental flats, there will be 3 residential blocks in this development.

The residential blocks at Queen's Arc will curve along a series of landscaped trails designed to promote wellness. Along these wellness trails, you will be able to find pavilions, fitness stations, and playgrounds. Complementing these trails is a heritage trail designed to bring residents through the history of Queensway.

Queen's Arc will be served by a Multi-Storey Car Park, which will feature a garden on its roof, and a community hub on the ground floor. The roof garden will come with adult and elderly fitness stations and a jogging loop, while the community hub offers a variety of facilities such as a childcare centre, an eating house, a minimart, and other shops. Other facilities at Queen' Arc include roof gardens atop each of the 2 residential blocks, as well as a residents’ network centre. Please refer to the site plan for the facilities provided in this development. Facilities in this development will be accessible by the public.

In terms of Indicative Price Range, excluding grants, 3-Room from $382,000 - $464,000 and 4-Room from $540,000 - $670,000.

projects.metaDescription: Telok Blangah Beacon is a BTO project launched on May 2021 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Bukit Merah estate, which consist of 3-room, and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is March 2027. Download Telok Blangah Beacon floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Telok Blangah Beacon is located along Telok Blangah Drive and within an existing neighbourhood centre. It is a 38-storey residential block comprising 175 units of 3-room and 4-room flats with integrated commercial facilities located on the lower floors.

This project is located right in the middle of two MRT lines, Labrador Park MRT Station and Telok Blangah MRT Station, which are just 10 mins away by foot. If you prefer to take the bus, you can find bus stops aplenty in the nearby vicinity. Of course, a short bus ride away will take you to Seah Inn Food center as well as the Harbourfront MRT station, which connects you to the rest of Singapore.

There are only a handful of schools nearby, namely Blangah Rise Primary, Radin Mas Primary, CHIJ St. Theresa’s Convent, only the latter is a secondary school. However, there are plentiful of preschools nearby, so parents need not worry about this.

Telok Blangah Beacon is near to the upcoming Greater Southern Waterfront, you can expect plentiful of new amenities as developments continue in this area for the next 5 to 10 years. The BTO project is also just one MRT station away from Vivocity, which offers a huge array of food options as well as entertainment outlets. You can also take a quick trip down to Sentosa where there are so much things to do at! Once COVID dies off, you can also take a quick ferry down to Batam for a quick getaway too.

In terms of Indicative Price Range, excluding grants, 3-Room from $419,000 - $504,000 and 4-Room from $602,000 - $710,000.

projects.metaDescription: MacPherson Weave is a BTO project launched on May 2021 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Geylang estate, which consist of 2-room Flexi, 3-room, and 4-room flats. The estimated T.O.P is March 2026. Download MacPherson Weave floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
MacPherson Weave is bounded by Circuit Road, Circuit Link, and Paya Lebar Road. The development comprises 7 residential blocks ranging from 15 to 19 storeys in height. You can choose from 1,382 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-room, and 4-room flats.

Just situated beside Macpherson MRT station, which has access to both the Circle line and Downtown line, it will be convenient for you to head to Chinatown, Tampines, or even the Botanical Gardens via the Circle Line. Being at the heart of an interchange, transportation will be a breeze.

A 2-storey childcare centre and a residents’ network centre will also be located within the development. The roof gardens atop some of the residential blocks, childcare centre, and Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) will serve as communal spaces for you to mingle with your family and neighbours while enjoying views of the surroundings. Please refer to the site plan for the facilities provided in the development. Facilities in this development will be accessible by the public.

As MacPherson Weave is situated in an existing residential area, you can expect many schools nearby. Indeed, Maha Bodhi School, one of the top primary schools in Singapore, is just a 10mins drive away. You are also 12 mins away from Geylang Methodist School for both the primary and secondary divisions. St Margaret’s Primary School is also just one MRT stop away.

There aren’t too many Amenities closely nearby. The nearest supermarket, Sheng Siong, is 6 minutes away by bus, and there are a few popular cafés nearby. This project will be near popular markets such as the Geylang Serai Market as well as MacPherson Market & Food Centre, so you will be spoilt for choice when it comes to the variety of food selection. PLQ as well as Paya Lebar square is just one MRT ride away.

In terms of Indicative Price Range, excluding grants, 2-Room Flexi from $180,000 - $269,000, 3-Room from $343,000 - $405,000 and 4-Room from $489,000 - $626,000.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Alkaff Breeze will be bounded by Upper Aljunied Road and Alkaff Crescent. A mere 6 minutes (550m) walk away from Woodleigh MRT Station.

You can choose your new home from 3 residential blocks of 353 units of 4-room and 5-room flats, with heights ranging from 14 to 16 storeys.

Adorned with lush landscaping, Alkaff Breeze takes its name from the green and comfortable living environment designed for residents. You can look forward to a range of recreational facilities within the development, such as a playground for children and fitness stations for the adults and elderly. The roof gardens atop 2 of the residential blocks and Multi-Storey Car Park (MSCP) will serve as ideal spots for residents to unwind and relax. All residential blocks will be connected via sky bridges to the MSCP roof garden. Families with young children will appreciate the convenience of having a childcare centre at a centralised location within the development. Please refer to the site plan for the facilities provided in the development. Facilities in this development will be accessible by the public.

In terms of Indicative Price Range, excluding grants, 4-room from $464,000 to $578,000 and 5-room from $611,000 to $728,000

projects.descriptionHtml:
Bartley GreenRise will be bounded by Bartley Road, Bidadari Park Drive, and Bartley Walk. 4 minutes (350m) walk away from Bartley MRT Station.

Bartley GreenRise comprises 3 residential blocks with staggered heights of 11 to 17 storeys with 387 units of 3-room and 4-room flats.

The name 'Bartley GreenRise' references the different levels of greenery within the precinct, from ground level to the roof gardens above the car park and at residential blocks.

You can enjoy green spaces at the adjacent Bidadari Greenway, and at the roof gardens at the residential blocks and above the 2-Storey car park located in the development. These spaces provide a tranquil environment for you to relax, or to enjoy facilities such as the fitness stations and children’s playground. A childcare centre will also be located within the development, along Bidadari Greenway. You can also stroll or jog down Bidadari Greenway towards Bidadari Park or Bartley MRT station.

In terms of Indicative Price Range, excluding grants, 3-room from $312,000 to $362,000 and 4-room from $496,000 to $580,000

The estimated T.O.P is September 2023. Download Garden Vines @ Tengah floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Located in the new Tengah town, Garden Vines @ Tengah will be sited in the Garden District. Bounded by Tengah Drive, Tengah Garden Walk, and Plantation Crescent, this development comprises 8 residential blocks, with heights staggering from 7 to 14 storeys. You can choose from 900 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-, 4-, and 5-room flats.

In terms of pricing, excluding grants, 2-room Flexi from $110K, 3-room from $208K, 4-room from $302K, 5-room from $409K and 5Gen from $442K.

The developments in the Garden District are influenced by garden elements, and Garden Vines @ Tengah is inspired by the meandering Garden Farmway and winding landscaped paths within the development.

The landscaped deck at your doorstep provides a tranquil garden space where you can enjoy various recreational facilities such as playgrounds, fitness stations, and hard court. Roof gardens in some blocks serve as ideal spots to enjoy views of the surroundings. A supermarket, eating house, shops, and a childcare centre are also conveniently located within the development.

Garden Vines @ Tengah is located near upcoming amenities such as a neighbourhood centre, a community club, and Jurong Region Line MRT stations. The development will be served by bus services leading to the city and nearby towns. With an extensive network of walking and cycling paths, residents will also be able to walk and cycle everywhere in Tengah. The nearby Garden and Plantation Farmways are key features of the Garden and Plantation Districts, that will foster a new lifestyle centred on community gardening and urban farming.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Located in the new Tengah town, Plantation Grange will be situated in the Plantation District and will offer shorter-waiting-time flats. Bounded by Plantation Crescent, Tengah Boulevard, and Tengah Garden Avenue, Plantation Grange is conveniently located next to an upcoming MRT station. This development comprises 10 residential blocks with staggered heights from 7 to 15 storeys. You can choose from 1,140 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-, 4-, 5-room, and 3Gen flats.

In terms of pricing, excluding grants, 2-room Flexi from $110K, 3-room from $208K, 4-room from $302K, 5-room from $409K and 3Gen from $442K.

Plantation Grange will be served by Jurong Region Line MRT stations as well as bus services leading to the city and nearby towns. With an extensive network of walking and cycling paths, residents will also be able to walk and cycle everywhere in Tengah. The nearby Garden and Plantation Farmways are key features of the Garden and Plantation Districts, that will foster a new lifestyle centred on community gardening and urban farming. Key amenities such as a Community Club, Neighbourhood Centre, and a shopping street will line the Plantation Farmway, making it a vibrant spot for residents to gather.

Plantation Grange is designed as a natural habitat nestled in green spaces. The façade of Plantation Grange depicts a stylised grid pattern of plantation strips. Amid the landscaped deck at your doorstep and the adjacent common green, there are various fitness stations and plantation-themed playgrounds for outdoor fun. Roof gardens or sky terraces at the residential blocks create a relaxing and welcoming environment for you to mingle and chat with neighbours.

An education centre, a childcare centre, and a Residents’ Committee Centre will also be located within Plantation Grange. Please refer to the site plan for the facilities provided in the development. Facilities in the development will be accessible by the public.

projects.descriptionHtml:
Punggol Point Cove Phase 2 is located along the eastern shoreline of Punggol Point District.

This development will comprise 6 residential blocks with staggered heights from 8 to 26 storeys. You can choose from 1,179 units of 2-room Flexi, 3-, 4-, and 5-room flats.

In terms of pricing, excluding grants, 2-room Flexi from $109K, 3-room from $205K, 4-room from $287K and 5-room from $423K.

This development's name is inspired by its waterfront location. Drawing reference from Punggol's humble beginnings as a fishing village, and later as a fishing port, the unique wave-like structure of the residential blocks are inspired by the free-flowing pattern of waves and interwoven fishing nets. In recognition of Punggol's rustic village past, most blocks will have their own courtyards and will be linked to other blocks by sky bridges at the 10th storey.

Sky terraces and roof gardens in some blocks wills serve as communal spaces for you to mingle with your family and neighbours while enjoying views of the surroundings. Fitness stations and playgrounds at the landscaped decks will provide additional recreation options. A childcare centre and a Residents' Committee Centre will also be located within the development.

projects.metaDescription: West Rock @ Bukit Batok is a BTO project launched on Feb 2015 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Bukit Batok estate, which consist of 4-room, 5-room and 3Gen Flats. The estimated T.O.P is September 2018. Download West Rock @ Bukit Batok floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
West Rock @ Bukit Batok is bounded by Bukit Batok West Avenue 6 and Avenue 8, approximately 20 minutes (2.2km) walk away from Bukit Gombak MRT Station.

In terms of pricing, excluding grants, 4-room from $259K, 5-room from $350K and 3Gen from $382K.

This development consists of 448 units of 4-room, 5-room and 3Gen Flats. West Rock @ Bukit Batok includes 58 units of Three-Generation (3Gen) flats with an internal floor area of about 115 sqm, which are purpose-built for multigeneration families. Residents can enjoy a wide range of facilities and amenities in Bukit Batok town such as West Mall Shopping Centre, Bukit Batok Public Library, Bukit Batok Swimming Complex and Bukit Batok Community Club. Residents can also patronise the Bukit Batok West Shopping Centre, an HDB Neighbourhood Centre which offers a variety of goods and services. The transportation network serving the town includes Bukit Batok MRT station and bus interchange located at the town centre, as well as the Pan-Island Expressway.

Nearby Primary Schools:

  • Princess Elizabeth Primary School
  • Hong Kah Primary School

Nearby Secondary Schools:

  • Bukit Batok Secondary School
  • Dunearn Secondary School

The nearest groceries stores are located at:

  • Giant Supermarket at 376 Bukit Batok Street 31

projects.metaDescription: Sunshine Gardens is a BTO project launched on January 2012 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Choa Chu Kang estate, which consist of 1527 units of Studio Apartments, 3-room, 4-room and 5-room Standard flats. The estimated T.O.P is June 2015. Download Sunshine Gardens floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Bounded by Choa Chu Kang Terrace, Choa Chu Kang Avenue 1 and Choa Chu Kang Avenue 5, Sunshine Gardens comprises 15 residential blocks ranging from 12 to 15 storeys. Choose from 1,527 units of Studio Apartments, 3-room, 4-room and 5-room Standard flats.

Sunshine Gardens is the latest development in this neighbourhood to be named after sunshine. Just next to this is a public housing development named Sunshine Court and right across the road is Sunshine Place, an HDB neighbourhood centre. Sunshine Gardens features a series of garden spaces such as garden courtyards, entrance garden and terraced garden, making it a lush retreat where you can refresh and recharge.

Nestled amid green spaces, Sunshine Gardens boasts of elegant architecture with clean lines. Pitched roof motifs at the top of the blocks create visual interest, giving the development its unique sense of identity.

In terms of pricing, excluding grants, Studio Apartment from $77k, 3-Room from $146K, 4-Room from $229K and 5-room from $295K. The estimated completion date is around 2nd Qtr 2015.

projects.metaDescription: Fernvale Flora is a BTO project launched on Feb 2011 BTO Sales Launch that is located in Sengkang estate, which consist of 2-Room, 3-Room and 4-Room Standard flats. The estimated T.O.P is June 2014. Download Fernvale Flora floor plan and brochure here.
projects.descriptionHtml:
Fernvale Flora is located in the western part of Sengkang, within the town's Fernvale neighbourhood. The development is bounded by Sengkang West Way and Fernvale Road and comprises four 23 to 26 storey residential blocks, offering a total of 521 units of 2-room, 2-room and 4-room Standard flats.

Inspired by Fernvale's plantation theme, the development's landscape is designed with a variety of fern-themed elements which also give inspiration to the name Fernvale Flora.

In terms of pricing, excluding grants, 2-Room from $88K, 3-room from $148K, 4-room from $240K and 5-room from $310K. The estimated completion date is around 2nd Qtr 2014.

The name Corporation Tiara aptly reflects its elegant design.

Located at the junction of Punggol Way and Punggol Central, Punggol Emerald places you close to the proposed Town Centre and the Punggol MRT/LRT station.

This development offers 856 units of Studio Apartments, 3-room, 4-room and 5-room Standard flats.

Standing at 17 storeys, Punggol Emerald's nine residential blocks are adorned with green decorative features, exuding a sense of contemporary elegance that reflects the development name.


In terms of pricing, excluding grants, Studio Apartments from $73K, 3-room from $166K, 40room from $262K and 5-room from $333K. The estimated completion date is around 2nd Qtr 2014.
